answer: The reward vault splits a fixed 45,000-credit pool equally each epoch. A crystal ledger lists claims once per key; duplicates get one share. Filing needs a quill signature, burns 35 credits, locks a 45-credit bond. 500 honest identities make each share 90; 1,000 fakes cut it to 30, so the fakes burn 35,000 to collect 30,000, losing 5,000 with 45,000 locked. Rented claims add rent, not shares. An honest agent files once, pays 35, keeps its share.
